Rugged Titanium Build: Made from spaceship-grade Titanium, the Valour Ring 1 is exceptionally strong yet effortlessly lightweight. The inside features a medical-grade hypoallergenic epoxy resin lining that delivers a smooth, barely-there feel, comfortable to wear all day, every day. Its refined matte finish adds understated elegance, allowing it to transition seamlessly from intense workouts to everyday wear.

5ATM Water Resistance: Rated for water resistance up to the depth of 50 metres, the Valour Ring 1 is built to handle shallow-water activities, rain, pool-side use, and short recreational swims with ease. Whether you’re washing hands or caught in unexpected showers, it stays protected and performs reliably through your day.

Up to 15 Days Battery with Wireless Charging in Case: The Valour Ring 1 features a rechargeable, non-replaceable battery that delivers up to 15 days of use on a full charge (varying by ring size and usage). With fast charging, the ring takes about 90 minutes to go from 0 to 100%. It comes with a wireless charging case that makes powering up seamless and effortless, while also doubling as a secure storage dock to keep your ring protected, organised, and easy to carry.

Next-Gen Precision Sensors: Inspired by the discipline Valour stands for, its advanced sensor engine captures your body’s smallest physiological shifts with exceptional precision. It auto-tracks key vitals including Heart Rate, SpO2, HRV, skin temperature, sleep stages, and naps. Moreover, you can view detailed health insights across daily, weekly, and monthly trends to understand your health patterns more clearly.
